summary: Open CC0 or CC BY data exist for single systems: Mimulus seed development in reciprocal hybrids, Drosophila pair-level hybrid inviability/sterility flags, and an illustrative table of F1 viability in animal crosses. None records the stage of failure across a representative set of first crosses, and no bird cross dataset was found.
